prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (spray tan vs UV beds, budget, location). I can give a specific recommendation if you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP code, or whether you want a spray (airbrush/Mystic) tan or booth beds.

Meanwhile, quick guidance so you get the right salon:
- If you want a safe, even color: choose a professional spray/airbrush salon with certified technicians and before/after photos. Look for salons that use recognizable solutions (e.g., DHA-based brands) and offer a patch test.
- If you want UV tanning beds: pick a salon that keeps beds well-maintained, shows bulb replacement records, and enforces eye protection and time limits.
- Read recent Yelp/Google reviews and look for comments about technician skill, cleanliness, and color longevity.
- Ask about technician training, the exact solution used, prep/post-care instructions, and refund/redo policies for spray tans.

If you want, tell me:
- Spray or UV?
- Your Charlotte neighborhood or ZIP?
I’ll pull up the top-rated options and give phone, address and what each salon is best for. Also, I can include pricing estimates and appointment tips.
